mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_book_sequence (id, ledger_book_id, next_value, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{ledgerBookId}, #{nextValue}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, ledger_book_id, next_value, create_time, update_time FROM t_book_sequence WHERE ledger_book_id = #{ledgerBookId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_book_sequence SET next_value = next_value + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{sequence.id} AND next_value = #{sequence.nextValue}
mapper.select: SELECT id, ledger_book_id, next_value, create_time, update_time FROM t_book_sequence WHERE ledger_book_id = #{ledgerBookId} FOR SHARE
